title: macro_lightning
summary: Constrain macroscopic dark matter with lightning
details: Constraints on macroscopic dark matter from lightning, on Earth and Jupiter. Released with the PRD paper.

highlight.alt: The macro_lightning logo: a dotted track through a cloud, ending below it in a black macro trailing a blue wake inside a yellow channel.
highlight.description: Constraints on macroscopic dark matter from the lightning it would trigger, on Earth and on Jupiter, released with the paper.
